name: Circle of Winter (Druid Circle)
body:
You draw power from the cold, dark places of the world. The cold and darkness are your friends.

Bonus Spells: sleep (1st), darkness (2nd), deeper darkness (3rd). creeping ice (4th), cone of cold (5th), freezing sphere (6th), hungry darkness (7th), polar ray (8th), polar midnight (9th).

Manifestation: Your skin is cold to the touch, your breath frequently mists even in warm weather and your hair or skin may be limned in frost. In the dark, your eyes reflect light like a nocturnal predator.

Granted Powers: You gain the following abilities as part of this circle.

Snow-Borne (Ex)

You have darkvision with a range of 60 feet, and can see through fog, mists and precipitation as if they did not exist. This removes any Perception penalties or concealment caused by such effects whether natural or magical. Additionally, you do not suffer from difficult terrain from ice or snow, nor do you have a chance of slipping on ice.

Long-Dark Nights (Ex)

At 8th-level, any spell you cast with the cold descriptor or that creates a darkness effect is automatically augmented by the metamagic feats Extend Spell and Widen Spell. This does not increase the level of the spell, nor does it stack with those meta-magic feats.

Polar Master (Su)

At 16th level, any spell you cast with the cold descriptor has a chance of freezing its target. An affected target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + 1/2 your legendary druid level + your Wisdom modifier) or be subject to this additional effect. If the spell slot used is 5th or lower, the target is staggered for 1 round. If the spell slot is higher than 5th level, they are instead paralyzed. The target must make the saving throw each round they are subject to the spell effect. If the creature is immune to cold, they are immune to this effect.

If the creature has cold resistance, they gain a bonus on the saving throw equal to their resistance value/5. For example, a creature with cold resistance 10 would gain a +2 bonus on their saving throw.

Druidic Talents

The following talents are available to legendary druids with this circle:

At Home in the Cold (Ex)

(Minor Talent)

You gain a bonus equal to your class level on Survival checks to survive in the wilderness and saves against cold environment effects. Additionally, when you sleep you may choose to enter a state of rapid hibernation. During this time you are immune to cold weather effects and heal back to your full hit points.

However, during the normal sleep period, you are in a deep sleep as per the spell even if you are normally immune to sleep effects. If you are awoken before the full rest period the additional healing is lost.

Born of the Frozen North (Ex)

(Major Talent)

You gain cold resistance equal to twice your class level. At 16th level, this becomes cold immunity.

Child of Long Nights (Ex)

(Major Talent)

You gain the monster ability see in darkness. This allows you to see in darkness perfectly as with your normal vision, including distance and color. Additionally, any spell that you cast that creates a darkness effect lowers the light level by one additional step.

Cold-Dark (Su)

(Major Talent)

When casting a spell that creates a darkness effect, you may increase the spell slot level used by 1 to have the effect deal cold damage equal to the spell slot used each round to creatures within the darkness. This additional effect does not increase the casting time of the spell. A darkness spell cast in such a way gains the cold descriptor.
